meta.title: LoomKit — Your brain's backup. Lives in Telegram.
meta.description: LoomKit — your personal life assistant bot on Telegram. Log expenses, calories, and reminders in plain English. No app. No friction. Just type.
meta.ogTitle: LoomKit — Your brain's backup. Lives in Telegram.
meta.ogDescription: Log expenses, calories, and reminders in plain English. No app. No friction. Just type.

hero.sub: Tell LoomKit what you ate, what you spent, what you need to remember. One plain-English sentence — it parses everything in parallel, weighs it against your goals, and replies.
hero.demoMessage: I ate chicken rice for dinner, $7
hero.demoReply: Logged. 1,340/1,800 kcal today, $335/$800 in May. On track — go easy on tomorrow's lunch.

chatDemo.body: LoomKit reads what you actually say — currency, calories, time, intent. Three seconds, one message, done. That's the whole workflow.

messages.user: Had a chicken salad, about 450 cals
Remind me to call mum in 2 hours

features.headline: Everything you track. One place you already live.
features.lede: Three things, done well. No social feed. No streaks shouting at you. No notifications you didn't ask for.

items.title: Expense logging
items.body: Just say what you spent. LoomKit categorises, converts currency, and logs it instantly.

items.title: Calorie tracking
items.body: Text a meal or snap a photo. No manual entry, no database search, no counting.
items.userMsg: chicken wrap and a flat white

items.title: Smart reminders
items.body: "In 2 hours", "tomorrow morning", "next Friday" — LoomKit speaks human, not cron.

goals.headline: Goals that LoomKit watches for you.
goals.lede: Set a daily calorie target and a monthly budget. Every log gets weighed against them — quietly, in the same chat. No dashboard to remember to open.
goals.tip: Try /goals or just say "track 1,800 cal a day". Change anytime — same way.

messages.bot: 700 kcal · 2,040/1,800 today. Over by 240 — plan a lighter morning?

messages.user: how am I doing this month?
messages.bot: $377/$800 spent · 47% in. Tracking better than April.

whyTelegram.headline: The best app is the one you already have open.
points: No download. No onboarding. No new password.
Telegram is already open. LoomKit lives there.
One message. Done. Back to your life.

comingSoon.headline: What's coming to the kit.
comingSoon.lede: The MVP earns its place. These build on top of it — same chat, more superpowers.
comingSoon.photoBody: You snap dinner with friends anyway. Forward that same photo to LoomKit — it reads the meal, estimates calories, logs the spend. Zero new behavior required.

items.title: Voice logging
items.body: Talk faster than you type. Voice memo in, structured log out. Built for the morning rush.

items.title: Sunday recap
items.body: Every Sunday, a short woven report — calories logged, top spend categories, your week vs your goals. Delivered in chat. No tabs.

items.title: Dashboard
items.body: Your data, visualised. A web view for the weeks you want to look at the numbers.

feedback.headline: Got thoughts? We actually read these.
feedback.lede: Bug, feature wish, half-baked idea, kind word — all welcome. We reply from a real keyboard.
feedback.messagePlaceholder: What's on your mind? Be as informal as you like — we are.
feedback.emailOptional: (optional — only if you want a reply)
feedback.success: Got it. Thanks — we'll write back if you left an email.

footer.tagline1: Built with love and too much caffeine.
footer.tagline2: Always in your pocket. Never in your face.

modal.headline: You'll need a whitelist.
modal.sub: LoomKit is in closed beta. Drop your Telegram handle and we'll add you within 48 hours.
modal.reasonLabel: What do you want to track?
modal.successBodyHtml: We'll ping @yourname on Telegram within 48 hours. Look out for a message from @Loomkit_bot.
